scope: Read-only human-authored linguistic audit of development text and already-frozen oracles; no inference, routing, handler or test execution. Tags overlap.
difficulty_definition: Author policy in build_development.py: hard for retained-history cases, more than one semicolon-separated required-operation group, or quoted_data_and_mixed_intent / ambiguous_requests / denied_actions families; other cases are medium, including all50 supplemental contract probes. standard/challenging author labels were mapped to medium/hard before freeze. No easy bucket was authored. This is not empirical difficulty.

methods.direct: The turn states an identifiable operation or question and its target without requiring a previous owner turn; conversational framing and explicit constraints are allowed. Missing-target clarify cases and seven context-dependent follow-ups are excluded. This overlaps paraphrase because a plainly specified task can use alternate vocabulary.
methods.paraphrase: Human-reviewed conversational, indirect, synonym-based or figurative expression of an operation, rather than merely copying a capability label. Explicit per-turn membership is recorded; these are authored-form judgments, not measured model difficulty or routing outcomes.
methods.slang: Conservative clearly colloquial/idiomatic surface language: quick snapshot/Got, chewing through CPU, hogging memory, sitting on GPU, bogged down. Technical abbreviations and ordinary contractions alone do not count. No claim of broad dialect or slang coverage.
methods.typo: The three intentionally misspelled owner turns: memroy, proceses, and usng plus memroy. Multiple errors in one turn count once; filenames and legitimate abbreviations are not errors.
methods.ambiguous: The eleven predeclared clarify turns lack an identified object, scope, referent or objective. The label records original author intent, not an observed controller question.
methods.mixed_domain: Two separately requested operations cross conservative task domains: compute telemetry plus battery/power, GPU memory plus filesystem storage, or clock plus personal calendar. Mentioning another domain as background or denying its action does not count.
methods.multi_tool: At least two separate required operation groups in the frozen per-turn oracle. Equivalent IDs inside one group do not count as multiple tools. This includes the two status-before-playback requests and ten compound evidence requests.
methods.no_tool: The frozen per-turn oracle explicitly requests explanation, conversation, writing or quotation analysis without any tool. This does not infer actual model behavior.
methods.follow_up: The second owner turn in each of ten genuine sequential cases. The first turn and seeded assistant history do not count.
methods.quoted_data: An owner-supplied quoted literal, or an explicit request to treat source instructions/content as data. A literal can be a legitimate action argument; the label does not by itself imply prompt injection.
